name: dandi
description: Dandi skills for Claude Code: feature specs verified against code and the running app, behavior-preserving refactoring, and UI/UX guidelines for Korean users. Skill instructions are written in Korean.

plugins.name: dandi-feature-docs
plugins.description: Document every feature as AI-reproducible specs in docs/features/, run them as regression tests on the real screen, audit staleness, guard commits, convert tests to Playwright/Maestro scripts, and build release notes.

plugins.name: dandi-refactor
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving refactoring and optimization with side-effect verification; check mode verifies without changing code.

plugins.name: dandi-kr-ui-guide
plugins.description: UI/UX, icon, color, typography and design-token guidelines for web, app and game products aimed at Korean users, distilled from Korean service benchmarking research.
